title: Set Shot Goal Kicking En Francais (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle french accordion accent
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now son, I am going to teach you in French today
I do not speak French
But the lesson is the same in every language

[Verse 1]
Four steps back, two steps across
Same routine every time, no coin toss
Eyes on the big sticks, breathe in slow
Drop it on the boot, let it go

[French Verse]
Quatre pas en arriere, deux a gauche du tir
Les yeux sur les poteaux, ne laisse pas flechir
Respire profond, routine bien ancree
Le but de quarante metres, c est ta liberte

[Chas reacts spoken]
Now I am not French son
But I understood every single word of that
Routine. Routine. Same. Every. Time.

[Chorus]
Set shot from forty, line it up true
Routine est le maitre, routine sees you through
Quatre pas et deux, shoulders and boot
Set shot from forty, watch it sail through

[Verse 2]
Factor in the wind, two metres left
Low tee into the wind, high when the wind has left
Same routine every kick, method stays warm
Same son, same, whatever the form

[French Bridge]
Le vent du sud, deux metres a gauche
Bas dans le vent, haut quand il se cache
Meme routine a chaque coup de pied
Meme fils, meme, quoi qu il se passe

[Chas spoken]
You see son, the French know about routine
Napoleon had a routine
Did not always end well for Napoleon
But the routine, son, that part was right

[Chorus]
Set shot from forty, line it up true
Routine est le maitre, routine sees you through
Quatre pas et deux, shoulders and boot
Set shot from forty, watch it sail through

[Outro]
Same routine son
En francais, en anglais
Thats my boy
